summary.business_type: E-commerce (DTC fashion) — hybrid with a visitable physical studio; pre-launch, hosted on a *.vercel.app preview subdomain
top_findings: About page contains fabricated 'bespoke tailoring, founded 2019' copy that contradicts the site's real small-batch ready-to-wear model — confirmed independently by two specialist audits (Content, GEO)
Zero structured data (JSON-LD) anywhere on the site — no Organization, LocalBusiness, Product, BreadcrumbList, or WebSite schema on any of the 5 indexable pages
No individual product page URLs — all 18 products live only as JS quick-view modals on one /collection page, blocking product-level ranking, Merchant Center eligibility, and deep-linking
No robots.txt, no sitemap.xml, no canonical tags anywhere, and a genuine duplicate-URL bug (/about and /about/ both serve identical 200s with no redirect)
Checkout funnel pages (/checkout, /checkout/payment, /checkout/complete) are fully indexable with no noindex, despite not being wired to real payment yet
quick_wins: Rewrite/delete the fabricated 'Founded in 2019... bespoke tailoring' paragraph in src/i18n/dict.ts (about.founding1-3) — a 10-minute content edit
Add public/robots.txt with Disallow rules for the three checkout routes and a Sitemap: reference
Add ClothingStore + WebSite JSON-LD site-wide in Layout.astro using the ready-to-use snippets in findings/schema.md — real business data already verified
Add <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow"> to the three checkout routes
Fix the /about vs /about/ duplicate URL by setting trailingSlash in astro.config.mjs, and add self-referencing canonical tags
Give the home-page hero carousel's 8 product images real alt text (currently alt="" on the site's most prominent visual)
Drop fetchpriority="high" from all but one hero/product image per page to fix the Poor LCP (5.9-6.2s) on home and collection

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Static SSR output (Astro, is_spa:false) — full content visible to crawlers with no JS rendering dependency
HTTPS + HSTS present sitewide with proper HTTP->HTTPS 308 redirects
Clean, flat, hyphen-free URL structure with no broken redirect chains
Unique, descriptive title and meta description on every page
Correct mobile viewport meta and CLS-conscious image width/height attributes

findings.title: No robots.txt at all (404)
findings.description: https://kath-ebon.vercel.app/robots.txt returns HTTP 404 on all fallback paths checked; not present in the repo's public/ directory.
findings.recommendation: Add public/robots.txt disallowing /checkout* and declaring the future sitemap.

findings.title: No sitemap.xml / sitemap-index.xml
findings.description: All conventional sitemap paths 404; no @astrojs/sitemap integration configured; astro.config.mjs has no site URL set.
findings.recommendation: Add @astrojs/sitemap, set site in astro.config.mjs, exclude /checkout* routes.

findings.title: No canonical tags on any page
findings.description: Zero rel=canonical tags across all 8 routes, combined with an active duplicate-URL bug (see below).
findings.recommendation: Add a canonical <link> in Layout.astro once astro.config.mjs's site is set.

findings.title: /about and /about/ both serve 200 with identical content, no redirect
findings.description: Same ETag and Content-Length on both trailing-slash variants; astro.config.mjs has no trailingSlash setting.
findings.recommendation: Set trailingSlash: 'never' (or 'always') explicitly in astro.config.mjs.

findings.title: Checkout funnel pages fully indexable with zero noindex
findings.description: /checkout, /checkout/payment, /checkout/complete all return 200, unique titles, no meta robots or X-Robots-Tag, and aren't excluded anywhere — despite not being wired to real payment.
findings.recommendation: Add noindex,follow to the three checkout routes and Disallow them in robots.txt.

findings.title: Security headers absent site-wide
findings.description: No CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on any route; only Vercel's default HSTS is present. No vercel.json exists.
findings.recommendation: Add a vercel.json headers block; tune CSP against the Google Fonts/Fontshare origins in report-only mode first.

findings.title: Zero structured data (JSON-LD) anywhere
findings.description: structured_data.block_count: 0 on every route checked.
findings.recommendation: See dedicated Schema findings — Organization/ClothingStore + WebSite as the minimum viable first pass.

findings.title: Thai-speaking primary audience gets no indexable Thai content
findings.description: Language toggle is entirely client-side (src/scripts/i18n.ts swaps innerHTML post-load); no /th/ URLs, no hreflang, <html lang> never changes server-side. PRODUCT.md states the primary audience is 'primarily in Thailand.'
findings.recommendation: Ship real server-rendered /th/ routes with reciprocal hreflang once resourced; flagged Medium here on core-crawlability scope, follow up with a dedicated hreflang pass.

findings.title: Site-wide cart/quickview/size-dialog boilerplate is injected as crawlable text on every page
findings.description: Layout.astro unconditionally mounts hidden CartDrawer/ProductQuickView/SizeSelectDialog on all 8 routes, diluting unique-content signal on thin pages like /privacy and /checkout/complete.
findings.recommendation: Not urgent functionally; don't treat this boilerplate as a substitute for real unique copy on thin pages.

findings.title: Deployed only on a *.vercel.app preview subdomain
findings.description: No custom production domain; no X-Robots-Tag noindex safeguard on the preview host, risking indexing the throwaway hostname before launch.
findings.recommendation: Password-protect the preview subdomain or add a blanket noindex header until the production domain is live.

findings.title: No IndexNow key file/integration
findings.description: No IndexNow submission code anywhere in src/.
findings.recommendation: Defer until production domain and sitemap exist, then wire up IndexNow via deploy hooks.

findings.title: Render-blocking third-party font CSS on every page
findings.description: Two synchronous stylesheets (Google Fonts + Fontshare) block first paint; homepage hero also eager-loads 3 fetchpriority=high images simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: See Performance findings for the full fix — self-host fonts, preload critical weights, single high-priority hero image.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Privacy Notice is specific, PDPA-referenced, and non-generic — a genuine trust strength and tone model for the rest of the site
Genuine, specific process facts exist (4-step 'How a piece gets made', 'touched by hand at least three times') that are real E-E-A-T assets once surfaced better

findings.title: About page contains fabricated 'bespoke tailoring, founded 2019' block that contradicts the actual business model
findings.description: src/i18n/dict.ts (about.founding1-3) describes a made-to-measure bespoke commission business founded in 2019, directly contradicting the site's actual fixed-SKU, small-batch, S-XL ready-to-wear model described everywhere else. Confirmed independently by both the Content and GEO audits — reads as unedited template/AI-draft copy never reconciled with the real business.
findings.recommendation: Delete or fully rewrite the block; do not publish an unverified founding date; align /contact's 'custom orders' framing with the actual cut-to-order-within-a-limited-run model.

findings.title: No named founder/maker, no credentials, no process photography of a real person
findings.description: The entire brand promise rests on 'hand-cut by a person,' but no individual is named or shown anywhere on the site — the single biggest credibility gap for a craft-quality claim.
findings.recommendation: Add a real maker/founder name and photo with a sentence of concrete experience.

findings.title: Collection page has no per-product content beyond name + price
findings.description: 18 SKUs share one page with a one-line blurb each; no fabric, care, sourcing, or run-number detail per item.
findings.recommendation: Add 80-150 words of real content per SKU — fabric, sourcing, fit notes, run number.

findings.title: Content depth is thin with near-verbatim repetition rather than elaboration
findings.description: The 'hand-cut/small-batch/made to last' triad is restated three times on the homepage before any new information appears.
findings.recommendation: Replace repetition with elaboration — one strong statement per page, freed-up space for concrete provenance detail.

findings.title: AI citation readiness undercut by buried facts and zero structured data
findings.description: Strong quotable facts exist but live only on /about, two clicks from the homepage, with no JSON-LD to confirm them machine-readably.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization/LocalBusiness + Product JSON-LD; surface the strongest process facts on /collection too.

findings.title: Contact email is a personal Gmail address, not a branded domain
findings.description: info.studiokath@gmail.com used site-wide instead of a domain-matched address.
findings.recommendation: Switch to a branded email once the custom domain migration happens.

categories.name: On-Page SEO / Search Experience (SXO)
what_works: Unique, descriptive titles and meta descriptions on every page
/about is well-aligned to SERP expectations for brand/craft-story queries
/collection is structurally close to a proper category/listing page

findings.title: No individual product detail pages — critical page-type mismatch
findings.description: Product-specific queries expect a dedicated Product Page (unique URL, schema, purchase CTA); Studio Kath has none — all 18 products are JS modal triggers with no href, sharing one title/meta description for the whole catalog.
findings.recommendation: Build /collection/[slug] routes from the existing product data; keep the quick-view modal as progressive enhancement, not the only path.

findings.title: Target head-term keywords in original brief return B2B/manufacturer SERPs, not consumer shopping results
findings.description: WebSearch confirms 'hand-cut small batch clothing Bangkok' and 'small batch clothing brand Thailand' are currently interpreted by Google as sourcing/manufacturing intent, not shopping intent — Studio Kath would be competing in the wrong SERP.
findings.recommendation: Reframe toward consumer-intent long-tail and editorial/PR-friendly phrasing ('limited edition clothing Bangkok' returns boutique/directory content, a more realistic near-term target).

findings.title: /collection under-delivers for category-level SERP expectations
findings.description: No ItemList/Product schema, no fabric/material info visible on the grid itself, no canonical tag.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList schema, one-line material/craft tags per card, self-referencing canonical.

findings.title: No Open Graph or Twitter Card tags on any page
findings.description: Confirmed empty on all 5 indexable pages — affects how links render when shared to social or cited by AI chat tools.
findings.recommendation: Add og:title/description/image/url and Twitter Card tags site-wide.

findings.title: Zero structured data site-wide — no Organization, LocalBusiness, Product, BreadcrumbList, or WebSite
findings.description: structured_data.block_count: 0 confirmed on all 5 indexable pages via direct fetch, no JS required. Layout.astro has no schema-injection logic at all.
findings.recommendation: Implement ClothingStore + WebSite JSON-LD in Layout.astro (ready-to-use snippet in findings/schema.md using real verified NAP data).

findings.title: No LocalBusiness markup despite a real, appointment-visitable studio address
findings.description: The /contact page explicitly invites studio visits and publishes a specific Bangkok street address and phone number, making ClothingStore/LocalBusiness schema directly applicable, not just generic Organization.
findings.recommendation: Use ClothingStore as a single-location entity; omit openingHoursSpecification until real hours or 'by appointment only' copy is published.

findings.title: No WebSite schema
findings.description: No entity tying the domain to the brand name for Knowledge Graph/sitelinks purposes.
findings.recommendation: Add WebSite JSON-LD referencing the ClothingStore entity as publisher; skip SearchAction until on-site search exists.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList on any interior page
findings.description: Flat, shallow site structure makes this a near-free addition.
findings.recommendation: Add a reusable BreadcrumbList partial for the 4 interior pages.

findings.title: Product/Offer schema should be deferred, not published yet
findings.description: No individual product URLs exist yet and checkout isn't wired to real payment — publishing Offer schema with price/availability now would misrepresent purchasability.
findings.recommendation: Add full Product/Offer schema once per-product pages and live checkout both exist.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: CLS is a perfect 0 on all four pages tested
TTFB is excellent everywhere (30-227ms) — Vercel edge is not a bottleneck
JS payload (Lenis, QRCode) is lightweight — TBT 0-50ms, ~24KB total script weight, not a bottleneck

findings.title: LCP fails 'Good' on all four pages tested; home and collection land in the 'Poor' band
findings.description: Lab data (Lighthouse, mobile emulation): / 6.2s, /collection 5.9s (both Poor, >4.0s), /about 3.5s, /contact 3.2s (both Needs Improvement). Element render delay (1.2-2.2s) dominates on every page, including two with no LCP image at all.
findings.recommendation: Fix render-blocking fonts and hero image priority contention (see next two findings) — both directly address the render-delay component.

findings.title: Two render-blocking font providers (Google Fonts + Fontshare) cost ~2.2-2.3s per page
findings.description: Both font CSS requests block render with separate DNS/TLS chains; Lighthouse estimates 2.2-2.3s savings per page from fixing this.
findings.recommendation: Self-host both font families, preload critical weights only, trim unused Switzer weights.

findings.title: Hero/product images oversized, over-compressed, with competing fetchpriority=high
findings.description: Homepage: 1,006 KiB wasted across 3 simultaneously eager+high-priority hero images. Collection: 424KB wasted across 7 flagged images, several serving 1206-1608px sources for ~650px display sizes.
findings.recommendation: Add responsive srcset/sizes via astro:assets; only the true above-fold LCP candidate should carry fetchpriority=high.

findings.title: Lab data only — no CrUX/PSI field data available
findings.description: No Google API credentials configured; PSI rate-limited. All numbers are single-run lab measurements, directional not final.
findings.recommendation: Re-validate against CrUX field data once the site has real traffic.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Fully static/SSR, no JS-rendering dependency — technically accessible to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot etc. today
Genuinely quotable process facts exist (hand-touched three times, 4-step numbered process) — a real citability asset once consolidated and marked up

findings.title: Same fabricated About-page content risks AI engines citing false facts
findings.description: If indexed, AI Overviews/ChatGPT/Perplexity could confidently state Studio Kath is a 'bespoke tailoring house founded in 2019' — wrong on both the founding year and business model.
findings.recommendation: Fix before any AI-search visibility push — see Content Quality Finding 1, same underlying issue.

findings.title: Zero JSON-LD blocks the machine-readable entity/shopping layer AI engines rely on
findings.description: No Organization/LocalBusiness/Product schema on any page; 19 real THB prices on /collection with no surrounding markup.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as Schema category — sequence after the content-accuracy fix.

findings.title: Brand mention/third-party authority signal is realistically at or near zero
findings.description: No YouTube, Reddit, Wikipedia, or LinkedIn presence; zero Common Crawl footprint; owned social channels aren't yet linked via sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Do not expect AI Overview citations at launch; prioritize video content, sameAs structured data (free), and eventual local press.

findings.title: Passage-level citability is fragmented into short fragments, not self-contained answer blocks
findings.description: No paragraph on the site reaches 100 words; 0 of ~30 headings are question-phrased.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate accurate facts into 1-2 self-contained ~140-160 word passages once Finding 1 is fixed.

findings.title: No FAQ or blog/article content anywhere
findings.description: 5 short marketing/transactional pages only — no topical content ceiling to expand into for category-level AI queries.
findings.recommendation: Post-launch: add a small 'Notes from the Studio' section, 3-5 short posts.

findings.title: robots.txt and llms.txt both entirely absent
findings.description: Ambiguous-by-omission rather than a deliberate AI-crawler policy.
findings.recommendation: Add both once a deliberate AI-crawler stance is decided.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Product photography is WebP, well-resolved (843x1123px+), and carries distinct, descriptive alt text throughout the collection grid and about page
Explicit width/height on all product and hero images — zero CLS from image loading

findings.title: Home page hero carousel (8 images) has empty alt="" on the site's most prominent visual
findings.description: The same photos have good descriptive alt text elsewhere on the page (e.g. collection grid), proving the team already writes good alt copy — it just wasn't applied to the hero.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the existing descriptive copy for the 8 hero__slide images.

findings.title: Decorative nav/social icons use bare alt attribute (cosmetic, not a real issue)
findings.description: A bare alt is spec-equivalent to alt="" and the parent links already carry accessible names — this accounts for most of the raw 'missing alt' count originally flagged.
findings.recommendation: Normalize to explicit alt="" only to stop third-party scanners false-flagging it; no user-facing impact.

findings.title: Hero and product images oversized/over-compressed for their display size
findings.description: See Performance findings — 1,006 KiB wasted on homepage, 424KB on /collection from serving full-resolution sources at small display sizes.
findings.recommendation: Responsive srcset/sizes via astro:assets.

supplementary_categories.name: E-commerce SEO
supplementary_categories.note: Not folded into the weighted health score (outside the standard 7-category framework) but material to the action plan.

findings.title: No individual product page URLs (same structural gap as On-Page/SXO)
Near-duplicate templated descriptions across 5 trouser colorway variants — thin-content risk once separately indexable
Marketplace links (Shopee, Lazada) are storefront-level only, no per-product cross-linking possible
Inventory tracked at product level only, no per-size stock signal
No shipping/tax line in checkout total — fine pre-launch, close before going live
No SKU/GTIN/MPN/brand fields in the product data model

supplementary_categories.name: Local SEO
supplementary_categories.note: Studio Kath is a hybrid DTC + appointment-visitable-studio business. Not folded into the weighted health score.

findings.title: No visible Google Business Profile signals; existence of a GBP is unverified and unverifiable from this tool
NAP exists in exactly one unstructured on-page source, missing ', Thailand' in the visible address
No dedicated 'visit the studio' content beyond a single address line
Social/marketplace brand handles are inconsistent across platforms (studio.kath / kathh.studio / studiokath)
No reviews/reputation signals anywhere — expected pre-launch, plan the solicitation cadence ahead of time

supplementary_categories.name: Backlinks
supplementary_categories.note: Tier 0 (Common Crawl only, no Moz/Bing keys configured). Not folded into the weighted health score.

findings.title: No backlink authority data exists yet — expected for a pre-launch site, not a red flag
Site is on a *.vercel.app subdomain — any backlinks earned now won't transfer to a future custom domain

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Delete/rewrite the fabricated 'Founded in 2019... bespoke tailoring' block in src/i18n/dict.ts
Add public/robots.txt (Disallow /checkout*, declare future sitemap)
Add noindex,follow meta tag to /checkout, /checkout/payment, /checkout/complete
Fix the /about vs /about/ duplicate-URL bug via trailingSlash config in astro.config.mjs
Add self-referencing canonical tags site-wide (requires setting `site` in astro.config.mjs)
Add ClothingStore + WebSite JSON-LD site-wide in Layout.astro (ready-to-use snippet in findings/schema.md)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Build /collection/[slug] individual product page routes from existing product data
Add security headers via vercel.json (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
Fix LCP: drop fetchpriority=high to a single hero image per page, self-host/preload critical font weights
Add descriptive alt text to the 8 home-page hero carousel images
Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to the 4 interior pages
Add Open Graph and Twitter Card tags site-wide
Manually verify whether a Google Business Profile exists for Studio Kath; create/verify one with 'by appointment' hours if not
Add named founder/maker content with a real photo

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add 80-150 words of real per-product content (fabric, sourcing, run number) once product pages exist
Add Product/Offer JSON-LD once product pages and live checkout both exist
Consolidate scattered process facts into 1-2 self-contained ~140-160 word answer passages with question-phrased subheadings
Align social/marketplace brand handles across Instagram, Facebook, Shopee, Lazada
Add the missing ', Thailand' to the visible on-page address
Expand the /contact 'visit the studio' section with real photos and Bangkok wayfinding notes
Migrate off the *.vercel.app subdomain to a custom production domain before any deliberate link-building/PR outreach begins

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Re-run Lighthouse with a full trace post-fix to confirm LCP stabilizes
Add @astrojs/sitemap once product pages exist so it captures them automatically
Ship real server-rendered /th/ Thai-language routes with reciprocal hreflang
Add llms.txt and a deliberate AI-crawler policy in robots.txt
Plan a steady, non-batched review-solicitation flow once real customers exist post-launch
Re-run backlink and Common Crawl checks after the domain migration
Add Organization sameAs links pointing to Instagram/Facebook/Shopee/Lazada at zero incremental cost
